description: Export a playlist's full item list as an M3U playlist file or a CSV spreadsheet. Pages every item; pass output_path to write a file (created with mode 0600) inside the configured output root, or omit it to get the document inline. CSV cells are formula-safe.

format.description: Output format: m3u (playable playlist) or csv (spreadsheet)

include_headers.description: Emit the #EXTM3U marker / CSV header row

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

output_path.description: Write the full document to this local file (relative paths resolve inside the output root, default ~/.spotify-mcp/exports) instead of returning it inline

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at output_path (refused by default)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: export_playlist
